desc: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.

desc: Two boys carry a big cardboard box together into an open garage, the up-and-over door raised and the lawn and fence bright outside. They set it down among other flat-pack boxes, open one and find a football, which the smaller boy lifts out and throws. A close shot shows one boy tightening the bolts of a pale wooden bunk-bed frame. Indoors the finished bunk bed stands made up; the two boys bump fists and then sit side by side on the bottom bunk, laughing at the camera.

desc: Inside a dark foundry shed with a corrugated roof, a freshly cast metal horse statue glows orange-hot as it hangs from chains above a mould box, gripped by long tongs, while chunks of black sand fall away below it. A smiling worker in a leather apron and gloves stands beside it holding a hammer, and another worker with folded arms watches from behind. A furnace glows at the back, a pale wooden model horse stands on a bench, and the floor is covered in sand and metal moulds.

desc: In a harbour with colourful wooden fishing boats in front of a honey-coloured church with two bell towers, a young priest in a white robe over a black cassock stands on the stone quay, raises a metal sprinkler and splashes water toward a young woman in a yellow jacket and rubber boots. She stands on a blue and yellow boat with her head bowed and her hands pressed together, then looks up and smiles at him with a hand on her chest as he lowers the sprinkler. Orange nets and ropes lie on the boat.
